Customer invoicing

Prepares invoices with every field your tax rules require, and checks the ones you already sent for missing fields, wrong totals and gaps in the numbers.

Watch someone use it

Example run with fictional figures: Northbrook Trading Ltd, invoice NT-2026-0418 to Harbor Retail Ltd, dated 31 October 2026, under UK VAT. The figures match the worked examples on the step-by-step page.

Claudewith the MosoFin customer invoicing skill

Can you prepare an invoice to Harbor Retail for the racking job?

Claude

Yes. Before I read anything, I need some answers. I ask them all at once, so the run does not stop again for each one.

  1. Do you want me to use MosoFin, or will you upload the data?
  2. Do you want me to prepare a new invoice, or check invoices you already issued?
  3. Which company is selling?
  4. Which customer, and what do I bill? I need the description, quantity, unit price and tax code of each line.
  5. What is the invoice date? What is the tax point, and when did you deliver each line?
  6. Which tax rules apply, and which fields and phrases must the invoice show? I never take this from your company's country.
  7. Which tax rate applies to each line? Do your prices include tax? Do you round tax on each line or on the total?
  8. What is your numbering scheme?
  9. What are the payment terms, the currency and the customer's PO? Where do the payment details come from?

Use MosoFin. Prepare one invoice from Northbrook Trading Ltd to Harbor Retail Ltd. 10 storage racking units at £180 and 6 hours of installation at £65. Invoice date 31 October. We delivered and installed on 28 October. UK VAT, full VAT invoice. 20% on both lines, prices exclude VAT, rounded on each line. NT- with the year, then a number. Net 30, pounds, no PO. I add the bank details myself, from our bank's letter.

MosoFinChecked the workspace and the company fileread-only✓
  1. WorkspaceNorthbrook Trading
  2. Company fileNorthbrook Trading Ltd, confirmed by name
  3. Invoice creationNo tool. A person enters the invoice
  4. ToolsRead-only tools only

The agent can read your books. It cannot change them.

Claude

Here is my plan. I prepare one invoice from Northbrook Trading Ltd to Harbor Retail Ltd, dated 31 October, under UK VAT with the full VAT invoice fields. I read the books from your MosoFin connection. I leave the bank details for you to add from your bank's letter. I cannot create the invoice in your accounting system. You get a draft and a proposed entry. Shall I start?

Yes, go ahead.

Claude

The next number is NT-2026-0418. It is proposed, not reserved. Two things need your answer before the invoice goes out:

Questions on the draft
ItemOn the draftWhat I see
Installation price£65.00 an hourStandard price £55.00. Harbor's last invoice £55.00
Tax pointNot givenInvoice date 31 October. Delivery 28 October

Is £65.00 the price you agreed, or a keying error? At 6 hours, the difference is £60.00. And which date is the tax point? It decides the VAT period.

£65 is the agreed price for this job. The tax point is 28 October.

Claude

Thank you. Here is the arithmetic. VAT on each line and VAT on the subtotal give the same £438.00, so there is no rounding difference:

NT-2026-0418
LineAmountVAT 20%
1 · Storage racking, 10 × £180.00£1,800.00£360.00
2 · Installation, 6 hours × £65.00£390.00£78.00
Subtotal£2,190.00£438.00
Total due, £2,190.00 + £438.00£2,628.00

The total is more than £250, so UK rules need a full VAT invoice. The draft shows both names and addresses, Harbor's VAT number, the tax point and the date of issue.

Claude

You delivered both lines on 28 October, before the invoice date. So the entry credits sales, not deferred revenue:

Proposed entry
AccountDebitCredit
Accounts receivable£2,628.00
Sales: products£1,800.00
Sales: services£390.00
VAT payable£438.00
Total£2,628.00£2,628.00

Your system makes this entry when a person enters the invoice. The receivable equals the amount due on the invoice.

Claude

I also checked your recent numbers, NT-2026-0390 to NT-2026-0417, with the voided invoices. Two numbers need a look:

Number check
FindingNumberWhat it means
Missing numberNT-2026-0402Not in the books, not voided
Number on two documentsNT-2026-0409Two invoices share it

A missing number usually means that someone deleted an invoice. Only your system's audit log can show that. I cannot read it.

Claude

The invoice is marked as a draft for review. The payment block is empty, for your bank details. Before you send it, check that Harbor's VAT number is still current. I do not create or send the invoice.

Do you want the draft as a PDF? If so, which file name do you want?

Yes. Call it NT-2026-0418 Harbor Retail.pdf

Claude

Here is NT-2026-0418 Harbor Retail.pdf, marked as a draft. Do you want me to save your settings for the next invoice?
